To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
transverse spin can be introduced in a relativistic quantum field theory, and it is responsible for the helicty flip of the proton in transverse polarized Drell-Yan processes.

(1) the transverse spin operator for massless particles is defined in the light front formalism; (2) the transverse polarization in the nucleon is described by the transverse spin operators in QCD; (3) the transverse polarized structure function g2(x, Q2) is the matrix element of the transverse spin of quarks in the nucleon.

transverse spin is a relativistic invariant, that it can be measured in the laboratory frame in transverse polarization experiments, and that it has a direct connection with the transversity distribution function.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the construction of relativistically invariant operators for transverse spin, which are essential for the description of the spin structure of the nucleon and for the analysis of the spin structure functions measured in deep inelastic scattering experiments.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
transverse spin in QCD is a relativistic invariant, and it can be measured in a transverse polarized DIS experiment.
the light-cone spin is not a good quantum number in light-front dynamics, but that the transverse components of the spin are well-defined and conserved.
the transverse spin operator in light front theory is a Lorentz invariant operator, and the transverse spin operators in light front QFT are constructed in a manifestly Lorentz covariant manner.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
transverse polarization in QCD is a real phenomenon.

transverse spin is an intrinsic feature of the nucleon, and the transverse spin operators can be constructed in light front QED and QCD, which are responsible to the helicity flip and the transverse polarized structure functions in deep inelastic scattering.
transverse polarized DIS is an effective way to probe the transverse spin structure in QCD.
The main takeaway from our work is that
transverse spin can be defined in an arbitrary reference system, in analogy with massive spin, and the complete set of spin operators can be constructed for massless particles in QCD.
transverse spin can be studied in a model independent way in the context of light front QCD.
transverse spin in QCD can now be treated on the same footing as the longitudinal one.
